name: Nutritempt
desc: Developed an innovative mobile app using Flutter to provide personalized recipe and restaurant menu suggestions based on users’ dietary restrictions and preferences. Built a comprehensive Nutritional Information Database for restaurant dishes to enhance user decision-making. Collaborated closely with restaurant owners to ensure the app’s recommendations aligned with real-world menu offerings. Led a team of 8 as Scrum Master, managing Agile practices, sprint planning, documentation, risk assessments, and conducting market analysis to optimize the app’s features and user engagement.
